content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few changes before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership transfers immediately upon creation before full payment is received, and I propose that ownership remain with the contractor until full payment of all amounts due under the agreement has been received. - Regarding the relevant clause on compensation, a portion of the payment is conditional upon formal client acceptance, and I propose making this amount payable within thirty days following the delivery of the deliverables. Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards,
